findings.message: dependency dsh-voice-core uses an unpinned git URL
findings.remediation: Pin all dependencies to immutable commit SHAs or version ranges.
findings.impact: Unpinned git/URL dependencies allow attackers to publish malicious versions at any time.
findings.attack_vector: Dependency resolves to a mutable ref (branch/tag) — attacker pushes a malicious commit to the ref.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
